findings.title: Expanded phone View & audio controls render outside their usable containing block
findings.observation: At390x844, combined-view-controls-phone.png displays the disclosure summary and editing toolbar, but no Camera perspective, Frame scene, quality or audio body. Final recording frames agree. Passing test only asserts Frame scene isVisible after the click; that permits an off-viewport or clipped element.
findings.sourceCorroboration: Pinned narrow CSS gives .adaptiveWorkspace .viewportControlStack > .viewInstrument position:static (three classes), which outranks the later .adaptiveWorkspace .viewInstrument position:relative (two classes). Its absolute .viewControlBody top:100% therefore does not use the intended positioned disclosure; the canvas has overflow:hidden. This explains the captured missing menu. No new source was inspected or credited.
